What Makes a Villain.text: In hero society a villain is anyone who uses a Quirk to commit a crime, from a purse-snatcher with a stretching arm to a killer, and most villains live small. The word covers motive no more than scale. Some villains are driven by money, some by grudges against a society that pitied or feared their Quirk, and a few by ideas about what heroes ought to be; nearly all of them depend on the underworld's middlemen. Most pros outclass a new villain in a straight fight, so the villains who last avoid fights, work at night, move often and never linger where they did the job. Capture means police custody, trial and prison, and Tartarus for the worst. Once a person is called a villain in the news, the label tends to stay.
